details: This publish of vant@4.9.14 ships the genuine Vant Vue UI library plus an injected install hook. package.json runs "node lib/utils/support.js" as a postinstall script; that file is a 609 KB javascript-obfuscator bundle (dictionary string array, _0x hex identifiers, index-shift decoder) whose payload is hidden among vendored tar/http helpers. At install time it performs an external IP/geo lookup: a GET request to hxxp://ipinfo[.]io/json (axios 1.7.9 user agent) is issued from the npm install process. The same obfuscated string table contains a second hardcoded endpoint on an IP-literal host, hxxp://80[.]78[.]28[.]72/tokens, together with cloud-CI environment identifiers (GITHUB_ACTIONS, CIRCLECI, GITLAB_CI, BUILDKITE, CI_NAME), the Alibaba Cloud credential file path /.aliyun/config.json, an authorization header name and an archive staging name "noderig.tar.gz" — the shape of a CI/cloud-token collection and upload routine executed on every `npm install`. No network request to a package function ever needs ipinfo[.]io or an IP-literal /tokens endpoint, and the upstream library has no postinstall hook at all. IOCs: hxxp://ipinfo[.]io/json, hxxp://80[.]78[.]28[.]72/tokens, /.aliyun/config.json, noderig.tar.gz.
